D3-123.exp: Jab Azure Spot VM evict karta hai to aap ki chuni eviction policy ke mutabiq ya to usay deallocate karta hai (disks rakhta hai, taa ke aap baad mein start kar sakein) ya delete karta hai. Stop ya Restart, Pause ya Snapshot aur Hibernate Spot eviction policies nahi.

D3-124.q: Ek VM ko SR-IOV use kar ke kam network latency aur zyada throughput chahiye. Kaun sa NIC feature?
D3-124.exp: Accelerated networking SR-IOV use karta hai taa ke network traffic host ke virtual switch ko bypass kar ke seedha VM aur network card ke darmiyan jaye. Is se supported VM sizes par kam latency, kam jitter aur zyada throughput milta hai. IP forwarding, static IPs aur kai NICs performance behtar nahi karte.

D3-125.q: Aap mojooda VM mein doosra NIC add karna chahte hain. Kya zaroori hai?
opts: VM deallocate karein, NIC attach karein, aur yaqeeni banayen ke VM size kai NICs support karta hai
VM ko naye subnet mein dobara banayen, kyunke NICs banate waqt tay ho jati hain
D3-125.exp: Network interfaces sirf VM stopped (deallocated) hone par add ya remove ho sakte hain, aur VM size itne NICs support karta ho. NIC add karein, phir VM start karein. VM dobara banane ya load balancer add karne ki zaroorat nahi.

D3-126.q: Ek VM firewall appliance ka kaam karti hai aur use woh traffic forward karna hai jo us ke liye nahi. Us ke NIC par kya enable karenge?
D3-126.exp: Default mein Azure NIC par aane wala woh traffic drop kar deta hai jo us NIC ke IP ke liye na ho. NIC par IP forwarding enable karne se firewall ya router VM doosre addresses ka traffic le kar aage bhej sakti hai (OS ko bhi forward karne ke liye set karna hota hai). Accelerated networking, DNS aur static IPs yeh nahi badalte.

D3-127.q: Managed disks ki server-side encryption (SSE) ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: Platform-managed keys ke sath default mein enabled hai
BitLocker keys se har disk par on karna parta hai
Yeh sirf data disks ke liye hai
D3-127.exp: Server-side encryption (SSE) managed disks par hamesha on hoti hai, default mein platform-managed keys ke sath. Apni key use karne ke liye disk encryption set banayen jo Key Vault ki key ki taraf point kare aur usay disks ko assign karein. Yeh OS aur data disks dono cover karti hai, manually enable nahi karni parti, aur BitLocker use nahi karti.

D3-128.q: Kaun sa resource managed disks ko Key Vault ki customer-managed key se jorta hai?
D3-128.exp: Disk encryption set woh resource hai jo managed disks ko Key Vault ki customer-managed key se jorta hai. Aap isay disks ko assign karte hain, aur yeh key tak pohanchne ke liye managed identity use karta hai. Encryption scopes Blob storage ke liye hain, aur Recovery Services vault backup ke liye.

D3-129.q: VMs par encryption at host use karne se pehle har subscription mein ek baar kya karna hota hai?
opts: Microsoft.Compute ke liye EncryptionAtHost feature register karein
Customer-managed key wala disk encryption set banayen
D3-129.exp: Encryption at host ko pehle subscription ke liye on karna hota hai, Microsoft.Compute provider ke liye EncryptionAtHost feature register kar ke. Us ke baad aap har VM par isay enable kar sakte hain. Disk encryption set sirf tab chahiye jab aap customer-managed keys chahte hon.

D3-130.q: Azure Disk Encryption ke liye kaun si Key Vault access setting enable honi chahiye?
opts: Azure Disk Encryption for volume encryption
Azure Resource Manager for template deployment
D3-130.exp: Azure Disk Encryption ko key vault ki 'Azure Disk Encryption for volume encryption' access setting (enabledForDiskEncryption) on chahiye, taa ke Azure platform BitLocker ya dm-crypt secrets store aur parh sake. Template deployment, purge protection aur network settings alag options hain. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga: nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host use karein.

D3-131.q: Kaun si CLI command VM par Azure Disk Encryption enable karti hai?
opts: az vm encryption enable -g RG1 -n VM1 --disk-encryption-keyvault kv1
az vm update -g RG1 -n VM1 --encrypt-disks all --keyvault kv1 --ade
D3-131.exp: az vm encryption enable VM ke liye Azure Disk Encryption on karti hai, --disk-encryption-keyvault vault ki taraf point karta hai (aur KEK ke liye optionally --key-encryption-key). Yeh encryption extension install karti hai, jo BitLocker ya dm-crypt chalata hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga: nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host use karein.

D3-132.q: Kaun se DO options VM ki temp disk encrypt karte hain?
opts: Azure Disk Encryption (volume type All par set)
D3-132.exp: Encryption at host VM ke host par temp disk aur caches encrypt karti hai. Volume type All ke sath Azure Disk Encryption guest OS ke andar temp disk encrypt karti hai. Server-side encryption sirf Azure storage mein rakhi disks cover karti hai, aur encryption scopes blobs ke liye hain. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga: nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host use karein.

D3-133.q: Kaun si CLI command 2 instances wala scale set banati hai?
opts: az vmss create -g RG1 -n vmss1 --image Ubuntu2204 --instance-count 2
az vm create -g RG1 -n vmss1 --image Ubuntu2204 --scale-set --count 2
D3-133.exp: az vmss create aap ki di hui image aur shuruati instance count, yahan 2, ke sath virtual machine scale set banati hai (yeh network aur default mein load balancer bhi banati hai). az vm create single VMs banati hai, aur baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-134.q: Kaun si CLI command scale set ko manually 5 instances par set karti hai?
D3-134.exp: az vmss scale --new-capacity 5 scale set ko manually 5 instances par set karti hai. Agar autoscale configured hai to woh apni agli evaluation par count dobara badal sakta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-135.q: Autoscale ka scale-out rule CPU > 70% par aur scale-in rule CPU < 65% par hai. Instances baar baar upar neeche hote hain (flapping). Behtareen hal?
opts: Thresholds ka farq barhayen aur cooldown periods use karein
Maximum hata dein aur dono rules ki jagah manual schedule lagayen
D3-135.exp: Flapping tab hoti hai jab scale out CPU ko scale-in threshold se zara neeche le aata hai, jis se ek instance hatta hai, jo CPU ko wapas scale-out threshold se upar le jata hai, aur yahi chalta rehta hai. Thresholds ke darmiyan bara farq rakhein (maslan 70% se upar out, 30% se neeche in) aur cooldown periods use karein. Maximum hatana ya minimum kam karna isay nahi rokta.

D3-136.q: Traffic har weekday subah 8 se shaam 6 tak peak par hota hai. VMSS ko pehle se andaze ke mutabiq kaise scale karein?
opts: Lambi duration wala metric-based CPU rule
D3-136.exp: Recurrence schedule wala autoscale profile tay waqton ke liye instance count set karta hai, maslan weekdays par 8:00 se 18:00 zyada instances aur baqi waqt kam. Yeh load aane se pehle scale karta hai. Metric rules sirf CPU barhne ke baad react karte hain, budgets scale nahi karte, aur manual scaling ke liye har subah kisi ko chahiye.

D3-137.q: Model badalne par scale set ki Rolling upgrade policy kya karti hai?
opts: Instances ko batches mein, optional pauses aur health checks ke sath update karti hai
Tamam instances ko ek sath update karta hai, health checks ke baghair
Scale set delete kar ke dobara banati hai
D3-137.exp: Rolling upgrade policy scale set instances ko batches mein, optional pauses aur health checks ke sath update karti hai, is liye app available rehti hai. Automatic tamam instances ek sath update karta hai, aur Manual har instance update karne ke liye aap ka intezar karta hai. Scale set delete nahi hota.

D3-138.q: Platform images (Uniform) use karne wale scale set ki zyada se zyada instance count kya hai?
D3-138.exp: Platform images use karne wale Uniform scale set mein 1,000 tak VM instances ho sakte hain (kuch configurations mein custom images zyada mehdood ho sakti hain). Yeh 10, 100 ya unlimited nahi.

D3-139.q: Kaun sa scale set feature kharab instances khud badal deta hai?
D3-139.exp: Automatic instance repairs har instance ki sehat dekhte hain, Application Health extension ya load balancer health probe se. Jo instances kharab rehte hain woh khud delete ho kar dobara bante hain. Rolling upgrades instances ko batches mein badalte hain, overprovisioning scale-out ke dauran extra VMs banata hai, aur Spot pricing option hai.

D3-140.q: Kaun si scale set setting instances ko availability zones mein phailati hai?
D3-140.exp: Scale set banate waqt aap zones 1, 2 aur 3 specify kar sakte hain, aur Azure instances ko un zones mein phailata hai taa ke set zone failure se bach jaye. Zones baad mein scale set mein add nahi ho sakte. Fault domain count instances ko racks mein phailata hai, zones mein nahi.

D3-141.q: Scale set ke autoscale evaluation logic ko tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Instance count ka change apply karein, min/max ke andar
Time window mein metric collect karein
Jama ki gayi value ka rule threshold se muqabla karein
Dobara evaluate karne se pehle cooldown ka intezar karein
D3-141.exp: Autoscale pehle time window mein metric (maslan average CPU) collect karta hai. Phir us value ka rule ke threshold se muqabla karta hai. Rule fire ho to instance count badalta hai lekin minimum aur maximum ke andar rehta hai. Phir dobara evaluate karne se pehle cooldown ka intezar karta hai taa ke instances sambhal sakein.

D3-142.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Scale sets Azure Load Balancer ke peeche rakhe ja sakte hain
Autoscale Application Insights ke custom metrics use kar sakta hai
Jab scale-out aur scale-in rules dono trigger hon to scale-in ko tarjeeh milti hai
Autoscale storage queue ke messages ki tadaad par scale kar sakta hai
D3-142.exp: Scale sets Azure Load Balancer ke peeche ho sakte hain. Autoscale custom metrics, jaise Application Insights wale, aur storage queue length use kar sakta hai. Jab scale-out aur scale-in rule dono trigger hon to performance bachane ke liye scale-out jeetta hai.

D3-143.q: Kaun si service dependency analysis ke sath VMs, NSGs, VNets aur load balancers ko ek sath regions ke aar paar move karna support karti hai?
D3-143.exp: Azure Resource Mover VMs, NICs, NSGs, VNets, public IPs aur load balancers jaise resources ko ek sath doosre region mein move karta hai. Yeh dependencies check karta hai taa ke jure resources group ki surat mein move hon. Azure Migrate zyada tar on-premises workloads ke liye hai, AzCopy data copy karta hai, aur Export template kuch move nahi karta.

D3-144.q: Aap VM1 ko doosri subscription mein move karte hain. Kaun se dependent resources us ke sath move hone chahiye?
opts: Us ki managed disks aur network interface
Kuch nahi — dependencies khud dobara banti hain
D3-144.exp: VM ko us ke dependent resources ke sath move karna hota hai: us ki managed disks aur network interface, aur virtual network agar NIC us par depend kare. Destination subscription usi tenant mein honi chahiye. Dependencies khud dobara nahi banti.

D3-145.q: VM1 RG1 se RG2 mein move hoti hai. Us ki resource ID ka kya hota hai?
opts: Badal jati hai, is liye purani ID use karne wale scripts update karne honge
Wahi rehta hai, kyunke resource group ID ka hissa nahi
VM ko naya naam milta hai
D3-145.exp: Resource ID mein subscription aur resource group shamil hote hain, maslan /subscriptions/…/resourceGroups/RG1/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/VM1. RG2 mein move hone ke baad ID badal jati hai, is liye purani ID use karne wale scripts, templates ya alerts update karein. VM ka naam aur region wahi rehte hain.

D3-146.q: Doosre region mein move hone wali VM par Azure Disk Encryption enabled hai. Aap ko kya dhyan rakhna chahiye?
opts: Target region mein Key Vault chahiye aur move ke hisse ke taur par encryption keys aur secrets handle karne honge
ADE VMs move nahi ho saktin
Move ke dauran encryption khud hat jati hai aur target region mein dobara on karni hoti hai
D3-146.exp: Azure Disk Encryption use karne wali VM ko apni keys aur secrets VM wale region ke key vault mein chahiye. Doosre region mein move karne ke liye target region mein key vault chahiye aur move ke hisse ke taur par encryption keys aur secrets wahan copy karne honge. Encrypted VMs move ho sakti hain, lekin encryption khud nahi hatti. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga: nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host use karein.

D3-147.q: Windows VM ka koi public IP nahi hona chahiye lekin internet se RDP par mehfooz tareeqe se manage ho sake. Behtareen option?
opts: Dynamic address wala public IP add karein
D3-147.exp: Azure Bastion aap ko Azure portal se TLS (port 443) par VMs mein RDP ya SSH karne deta hai, VMs par public IPs ke baghair aur port 3389 internet ke liye khole baghair. 3389 Any ke liye kholna brute-force attacks ko dawat deta hai, aur public IP VM ko zahir kar deta hai. FTP ka is se taluq nahi.

D3-148.q: Kaun sa security feature Secure Boot aur vTPM ke sath VMs ko boot-level malware se bachata hai?
D3-148.exp: Trusted launch Generation 2 VMs par Secure Boot (sirf signed boot components load ho sakte hain), virtual TPM aur boot integrity monitoring on karta hai, jo unhein rootkits aur boot-level malware se bachata hai. Encryption at host data at rest bachati hai, accelerated networking networking tez karta hai, aur just-in-time access management ports mehdood karta hai.

D3-149.q: Kaun si VM generation UEFI boot aur bari OS disks support karti hai?
D3-149.exp: Generation 2 VMs BIOS ke bajaye UEFI se boot hoti hain, 2 TB se bari OS disks support karti hain, aur Trusted launch jaise features ke liye zaroori hain. Generation 1 BIOS use karti hai. Classic purana deployment model hai, VM generation nahi.

D3-150.ctx: VM1: Standard_D2s_v5, availability set AS1 mein (3 FDs, 5 UDs), Premium SSD OS disk, Standard SKU public IP, usi region ke KV1 ke sath ADE enabled.
D3-150.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: VM1 ki properties edit kar ke usay availability zone 2 mein move kiya ja sakta hai
VM1 deallocate karne se dobara start hone par us ka public IP address badal jata hai
VM1 ko alag hardware wale size par resize karne ke liye AS1 ki tamam VMs stop karni par sakti hain
KV1 VM1 se alag region mein ho sakta hai
D3-150.exp: Zone placement ke liye dobara banana hota hai; Standard public IP static hai, is liye deallocation ke baad address rakhta hai; availability set ke andar resize ke liye tamam VMs stop karni par sakti hain; ADE vault usi region mein hona chahiye. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga: nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host use karein.

D3-151.q: Azure Container Registry kis liye use hota hai?
opts: Private container images aur artifacts store aur manage karne ke liye
Containers chalana aur demand ke mutabiq scale karna
Containers ko load balance karne ke liye
D3-151.exp: Azure Container Registry container images, Helm charts aur doosre OCI artifacts store aur manage karne ki private registry hai, jahan aap deploy karte hain us ke qareeb. Yeh containers nahi chalata — ACI, Container Apps, AKS ya App Service chalate hain — aur unhein load-balance ya monitor nahi karta.

D3-152.q: Kaun si CLI command Standard container registry banati hai?
opts: az acr create -g RG1 -n myacr --sku Standard
az acr new -g RG1 -n myacr --tier Standard --create
D3-152.exp: az acr create -n myacr --sku Standard registry banati hai. --sku Basic, Standard ya Premium ho sakta hai. Registry ka naam globally unique hona chahiye, kyun ke woh myacr.azurecr.io banta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-153.q: docker se push karne se pehle apni Entra identity se ACR mein authenticate kaise karein?
opts: Apne Entra password ke sath docker login
D3-153.exp: az acr login --name myacr aap ke mojooda Azure CLI (Entra) sign-in se registry ka token leti hai aur Docker ko us ke sath configure karti hai, is liye docker push aur docker pull chalte hain. Admin password ki zaroorat nahi. Akela az login Docker configure nahi karta, aur az acr credential show admin credentials zahir karti hai.

D3-154.q: Registry myacr mein push karne ke liye image ka poora naam format kya hai?
D3-154.exp: Azure Container Registry mein images registry ke login server ke naam par hoti hain: <registry>.azurecr.io/<repository>:<tag>, maslan myacr.azurecr.io/app:v1. Login server ke baghair Docker Docker Hub samajhta hai.

D3-155.q: Private endpoints (Private Link) ke liye kaun si ACR SKU zaroori hai?
D3-155.exp: Azure Container Registry ke private endpoints (Private Link) ko Premium SKU chahiye, geo-replication aur doosre advanced network features ki tarah. Basic aur Standard registries tak sirf un ke public endpoint se pohancha ja sakta hai.

D3-156.q: CI pipeline ko ACR mein images push karni hain. Least-privilege role?
D3-156.exp: AcrPush identity ko images push (aur pull bhi) karne deta hai, jo CI pipeline ko bas chahiye. AcrPull sirf pull kar sakta hai, is liye push fail honge. Owner aur Contributor bohat wide hain, kyun ke registry delete ya reconfigure bhi kar sakte hain.

D3-157.q: Base image update hone par images khud dobara build honi chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
opts: Base image update triggers ke sath ACR Tasks
D3-157.exp: ACR Tasks images khud build kar sakte hain jab un ki base image badle (base image update trigger), jab source code commit ho, ya schedule par. Is se images patched rehti hain. Geo-replication registries ko regions mein copy karta hai, webhooks sirf notify karte hain, aur content trust images sign karta hai.

D3-158.q: Docker Hub se image ko locally pull kiye baghair ACR mein kaise copy karein?
D3-158.exp: az acr import kisi doosri registry, jaise Docker Hub ya doosri ACR, se image ko server side par seedha aap ki registry mein copy karti hai, aap ki machine par pull kiye baghair. az acr build source code se build karti hai, aur az acr replicate mojood nahi.

D3-159.q: Production ke liye ACR admin account se kyun mana kiya jata hai?
opts: Yeh ek shared username aur password hai jis ke paas poore push/pull rights hain aur har user ki auditing nahi
Sirf Premium SKU par chalta hai aur banne ke baad us ka password dobara generate nahi ho sakta
Yeh sirf Premium ke sath chalta hai
D3-159.exp: Admin account ek shared username aur password hai jis ke paas poori registry ke poore push aur pull rights hain. Aap isay scope nahi kar sakte, aur pata nahi chal sakta ke kis ne use kiya. Microsoft is ke bajaye Entra identities (AcrPull jaise roles wale users, service principals ya managed identities), ya repository-scoped tokens recommend karta hai.

D3-160.q: Kaun si CLI command public DNS label wala container instance banati hai?
opts: az container create -g RG1 -n web --image mcr.microsoft.com/azuredocs/aci-helloworld --dns-name-label myweb --ports 80
az webapp create -g RG1 -n web --container mcr.microsoft.com/azuredocs/aci-helloworld --public-dns-name myweb --port 80
D3-160.exp: az container create container instance chalati hai. --dns-name-label myweb usay public naam (myweb.<region>.azurecontainer.io) deta hai aur --ports 80 port 80 kholta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi, aur az webapp create is ke bajaye App Service app banati hai.

D3-161.q: Kaun si CLI command chalte container instance ke logs dikhati hai?
D3-161.exp: az container logs dikhati hai ke container instance ke container ne stdout aur stderr par kya likha. Stream karne ke liye --follow add karein. docker logs sirf aap ke local Docker ke sath chalta hai, aur baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-162.q: Aap ko ACI mein chalte container ke andar interactive shell chahiye. Kya use karenge?
D3-162.exp: az container exec chalte container ke andar command chalati hai, maslan interactive shell kholne ke liye /bin/sh. ACI SSH, Bastion ya serial console offer nahi karta.

D3-163.q: Container ruk jane ke baad bhi container data baqi rehna chahiye. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Azure Files share ko volume ke taur par mount karein
Container ki local disk use karein
D3-163.exp: Container ruk ya restart hone par us ka apna file system kho jata hai. Data rakhne ke liye Azure Files share ko volume ke taur par mount karein; wahan likha data baqi rehta hai. emptyDir aur secret volumes waqti ya read-only hain.

D3-164.q: ACI mein CPU aur memory kaise assign hoti hai?
opts: Aap har container ke liye vCPU aur memory mangte hain aur per second bill hota hai
VM size chun kar, jo subscription ke tamam containers share karte hain
D3-164.exp: ACI mein aap har container ke liye CPU aur memory request karte hain (maslan --cpu 1 --memory 1.5), aur container group chalne ke dauran jo request kiya us ka per second bill hota hai. Aap VM size nahi chunte ya App Service plan use nahi karte, aur resources 1 vCPU aur 1 GB par fixed nahi.

D3-165.q: Container instance ko public IP ke baghair VNet1 ke private IP par database tak pohanchna hai. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Container group ko VNet1 ke delegated subnet mein deploy karein
VNet1 mein container instance ka service endpoint add karein
D3-165.exp: Container group ko VNet1 ke subnet mein deploy karne se (subnet Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups ko delegated hota hai) usay private IP milta hai, is liye woh baghair public IP ke database tak privately pohanch sakta hai. Akeli peering container ko network mein nahi dalti, aur service endpoints PaaS services ke liye hain.

D3-166.q: ACI container ko database password kaise dein taa ke woh portal mein na dikhe?
D3-166.exp: Secure environment variables (--secure-environment-variables) container ko diye jate hain lekin portal ya CLI mein container ki properties mein nazar nahi aate. Aam environment variables har us shakhs ko nazar aate hain jo container group parh sake. Secrets kabhi image names ya tags mein na rakhein.

D3-167.q: ACI par multi-container group (app plus sidecar) kaise deploy karte hain?
opts: Container group define karne wali YAML file ya ARM template se
Usi group mein har container ke liye ek az container create se
D3-167.exp: Kai containers wala container group (maslan app plus sidecar) ek YAML file ya ARM/Bicep template mein define hota hai aur az container create --file se deploy hota hai. Har container ke liye ek baar az container create chalane se alag groups banenge. Portal multi-container groups nahi bana sakta.

D3-168.q: ACI deployment ko kaise scale karte hain?
opts: ACI mein built-in autoscale nahi; zyada container groups deploy karein ya resource requests badlein
Container group ke CPU metric par autoscale rules banayen aur maximum 10 rakhein
D3-168.exp: ACI mein built-in autoscaling nahi: har container group aap ki request ki gayi CPU aur memory par chalta hai. Zyada load ke liye zyada container groups deploy karein ya bari requests ke sath redeploy karein. Automatic scaling ke liye Azure Container Apps ya AKS use karein.

D3-169.q: Azure Container Apps mein woh boundary kya hai jo VNet aur Log Analytics workspace share karne wali apps ko group karti hai?
D3-169.exp: Container Apps environment container apps ke group ki shared boundary hai: woh virtual network, ingress aur logging (Log Analytics workspace) share karti hain, aur ek doosre tak pohanch sakti hain. Container group ACI ka concept hai, App Service plan App Service ke liye hai, aur resource group sirf management ke liye.

D3-170.q: Container Apps mein revision kya hai?
opts: Container app version ka immutable snapshot
Ek container app se jura scaling rule
D3-170.exp: Revision container app ke kisi version ka immutable snapshot hai. Revision-scoped settings, jaise image ya environment variables, badalne se nayi revision banti hai, aur aap kai revisions chala kar un ke darmiyan traffic baant sakte hain. Yeh backup, lock ya scaling rule nahi.

D3-171.q: Container app ke naye version par 20% traffic aur purane par 80% bhejna hai. Aap kya configure karenge?
opts: Traffic splitting (weights) ke sath multiple revision mode
Weighted DNS record ke sath do alag environments
D3-171.exp: Multiple revision mode mein container app ek sath kai revisions chala sakti hai, aur aap un ke darmiyan traffic weights set karte hain (maslan purani revision ko 80% aur nayi ko 20%) canary release ke liye. Alag environments, Application Gateway ya DNS changes ki zaroorat nahi.

D3-172.q: Kaun sa Container Apps scale rule type concurrent HTTP requests par scale karta hai?
D3-172.exp: HTTP scale rule concurrent HTTP requests ki tadaad ki buniyad par Container Apps replicas add ya remove karta hai. Doosre rule types events (jaise queues) ke liye KEDA scalers, ya CPU aur memory use karte hain. Schedule aur manual settings request load par react nahi karti.

D3-173.q: Container app sirf usi environment ki doosri apps se pohanch mein honi chahiye. Kaun si ingress setting?
D3-173.exp: Internal ingress container app ko sirf us ke Container Apps environment ke andar se (aur jis VNet se jura ho) pohanch mein rakhta hai, internet se nahi. External ingress usay public karta hai, aur bilkul ingress na ho to koi doosri app usay HTTP par call nahi kar sakti.

D3-174.q: Raat ka scheduled batch task Container Apps mein chal kar khatam hona chahiye. Kaun sa resource?
D3-174.exp: Container Apps job container ko mukammal hone tak chalata hai aur phir ruk jata hai. Jobs manually, schedule (cron) par ya events se trigger ho sakti hain. Kam az kam ek replica wali container app hamesha chalti rahegi, ACR Tasks images build karte hain, aur VMSS manage karna kahin zyada hai.

D3-175.q: Kaun si DO services aap ke Kubernetes manage kiye baghair load ke hisaab se containers khud scale kar sakti hain?
opts: Autoscale ke sath Azure App Service (Web App for Containers)
D3-175.exp: Azure Container Apps HTTP aur KEDA rules se khud scale hoti hai (zero tak samet), aur App Service (Web App for Containers) autoscale rules se scale out hoti hai, aap ke Kubernetes manage kiye baghair. ACI mein autoscaling nahi, aur ACR sirf images store karta hai.

D3-176.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Container Apps zero replicas tak scale ho sakti hai
ACI Windows containers support karta hai
ACR Basic geo-replication support karta hai
Container Apps Dapr integration support karti hai
D3-176.exp: Container Apps zero replicas tak scale down ho sakti hai aur microservices ke liye Dapr support karti hai. ACI Windows containers chala sakta hai. Azure Container Registry mein geo-replication sirf Premium tier mein hai, Basic mein nahi.

D3-177.q: Kaun sa App Service tier shared infrastructure aur custom domains ke baghair muft development aur testing ke liye hai?
D3-177.exp: Free (F1) tier apps ko shared infrastructure par muft chalata hai, development aur testing ke liye. Is ke quotas hain aur custom domains, scaling ya SLA nahi. Standard, Premium aur Isolated paid production tiers hain.

D3-178.q: SSL bindings ke sath custom domains aur dedicated compute support karne wala sab se neecha tier kaun sa hai?
D3-178.exp: Basic sab se neecha tier hai jis mein dedicated compute instances, custom domains aur TLS/SSL bindings hain, halan ke scaling sirf manual aur mehdood hai. Free aur Shared shared infrastructure par chalte hain aur TLS ke sath custom domains use nahi kar sakte. Standard autoscale aur slots add karta hai, lekin minimum nahi.

D3-179.q: Ek app ko aap ke VNet ke andar single-tenant environment mein poori network isolation aur bohat zyada scale chahiye. Kaun sa tier?
opts: Regional VNet integration ke sath Premium v3
D3-179.exp: Isolated v2 tier App Service Environment v3 mein chalta hai, jo aap ke apne virtual network ke andar single-tenant deployment hai. Is se poori network isolation aur bohat zyada scale milta hai. Premium v3, Standard aur Basic shared multi-tenant infrastructure par chalte hain, chahe VNets se integrate ho sakein.

D3-180.q: Teen web apps 2 instances wale ek App Service plan mein chalti hain. Har app kitne instances par chalti hai?
opts: 2 — har app plan ke tamam instances par chalti hai
Kul 6, har app ke 2 alag bill
D3-180.exp: App Service plan ki har app plan ke tamam instances par chalti hai. 2 instances ke sath teeno apps dono par chalti hain. Aap plan ke instances ke paise dete hain, har app ke nahi. Plan scale karna us ki har app par asar dalta hai.

D3-181.q: Kya web app ko doosre region ke App Service plan mein move kar sakte hain?
opts: Nahi — plan usi resource group aur region mein hona chahiye
Haan — lekin sirf jab dono plans Premium tier mein hon
D3-181.exp: App sirf usi resource group aur region (wahi 'webspace') ke doosre App Service plan mein move ho sakti hai. Doosre region mein chalane ke liye wahan ke plan mein nayi app banayen aur code dobara deploy karein (ya app clone karein). Tier aur operating system is ko nahi badalte.

D3-182.q: Standard App Service plan ki zyada se zyada instance count kya hai?
D3-182.exp: Standard App Service plan zyada se zyada 10 instances tak scale out ho sakta hai. Basic 3 tak, Premium v3 30 tak, aur Isolated 100 tak — is liye agar 10 se zyada chahiye to ooncha tier lein.

D3-183.q: Ek app ko autoscale rules likhe baghair HTTP traffic par foran scale out hona chahiye (Premium v2/v3). Kaun sa feature?
D3-183.exp: Automatic scaling, jo Premium v2 aur v3 par available hai, App Service ko HTTP traffic ki buniyad par instances add aur remove karne deta hai, aap ko autoscale rules likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh jaldi react karta hai aur instances warm rakhta hai. Manual aur scheduled scaling ko aap ki settings chahiye, aur slots deployment ke liye hain.

D3-184.q: Kaun si CLI command mojooda plan mein web app banati hai?
opts: az webapp create -g RG1 -p plan1 -n myapp123 --runtime "DOTNETCORE:8.0"
az appservice create -g RG1 -p plan1 -n myapp123 --stack "DOTNETCORE:8.0"
D3-184.exp: az webapp create mojooda App Service plan (-p) mein globally unique naam (-n) aur "DOTNETCORE:8.0" jaise runtime ke sath web app banati hai. Naam <name>.azurewebsites.net ban jata hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-185.q: Kaun si CLI command S1 tier par Linux App Service plan banati hai?
opts: az appservice plan create -g RG1 -n plan1 --sku S1 --is-linux
az appservice create -g RG1 -n plan1 --tier S1 --os linux --new-plan
D3-185.exp: az appservice plan create App Service plan banati hai. --sku S1 Standard tier set karta hai aur --is-linux isay Linux plan banata hai, jo Linux web apps ko chahiye. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-186.q: Ek app apni database connection string rakhti hai. Non-secret settings aur secret references kahan jane chahiye?
D3-186.exp: App settings aur connection strings app ko environment variables ke taur par milti hain, is liye configuration code se bahar rehti hai. Secrets ke liye setting mein Key Vault reference (@Microsoft.KeyVault(...)) use karein, taa ke secret Key Vault mein rahe. Settings hard-code karna ghair-mehfooz hai, aur tags aur plan configuration ke liye nahi.

D3-187.q: App Service settings mein Key Vault reference resolve nahi hota. Sab se aam missing cheez kya hai?
opts: App ki managed identity ke paas vault par permission nahi
Vault app se alag region mein hona chahiye
D3-187.exp: Key Vault reference sirf tab chalta hai jab app ki managed identity secret parh sake: Key Vault Secrets User jaisa role (RBAC model ke sath) ya Get secret access policy. Is ke baghair setting resolve nahi hoti. Free se upar koi bhi tier chalta hai, vault kisi bhi region mein ho sakta hai, aur slots se farq nahi parta.

D3-188.q: Traffic na hone par continuous WebJobs chalna band ho jate hain. Kaun si setting yeh theek karti hai?
D3-188.exp: Always On ke baghair App Service taqreeban 20 minute baghair requests ke idle app ko unload kar deta hai, jis se continuous WebJobs bhi ruk jate hain. Always On app ko loaded rakhta hai (Basic se available). ARR affinity, HTTP/2 aur Auto heal app ko chalta nahi rakhte.

D3-189.q: Kai instances ke peeche stateless app ka load ghair-mutawazin hai kyun ke users ek instance se chipke rehte hain. Aap kya disable karenge?
D3-189.exp: ARR affinity (default mein on) cookie set karta hai jo har user ko wapas usi instance par bhejti hai. Stateless app ko is ki zaroorat nahi, aur is se kuch instances overloaded reh sakte hain. ARR affinity band karne se load balancer requests barabar baant sakta hai. Baqi settings distribution par asar nahi dalti.

D3-190.q: App Service ko /health endpoint check mein fail hone wale instance ko traffic bhejna band karna chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
D3-190.exp: Health check har instance par aap ka chuna path, jaise /health, ping karta hai. Jo instance baar baar fail ho woh load balancer rotation se nikal jata hai (aur kharab rehne par badal diya jata hai). Auto heal aap ki shartein poori hone par restart karta hai, access restrictions callers filter karti hain, aur logging sirf events record karti hai.

D3-191.q: Standard tier mein ek app ke kitne staging slots ho sakte hain?
D3-191.exp: Standard tier har app ke 5 staging slots deta hai, aur Premium aur Isolated 20. Free, Shared aur Basic slots support nahi karte, is liye staging slot chahiye to kam az kam Standard chahiye.

D3-192.q: Kaun si CLI command staging slot ko production se swap karti hai?
opts: az webapp deployment slot swap -g RG1 -n myapp --slot staging --target-slot production
az webapp swap -g RG1 -n myapp --from-slot staging --to-slot production --preview
D3-192.exp: az webapp deployment slot swap --slot staging --target-slot production staging slot ko production mein swap karti hai (pehle usay warm up karti hai). Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D3-193.q: Aap chahte hain ke production ke 10% users testing ke liye staging slot par jayen. Kaun sa feature?
D3-193.exp: Testing in production (traffic routing) production traffic ka kuch percentage, jaise 10%, doosre slot par bhejta hai, is liye asli users naya version try karte hain jab ke baqi production par rehte hain. Swap with preview traffic baantne ke bajaye swap ko rokta hai, aur access restrictions aur ARR affinity users ko slots ke darmiyan route nahi karte.

D3-194.q: Har baar staging par code push hone par warm-up ke baad woh khud production mein swap hona chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
D3-194.exp: Staging slot par auto swap enable hone se staging par har deployment warm up ho kar khud production mein swap hota hai, koi manual step nahi. Traffic routing users ko slots mein baantta hai, swap with preview ko aap ko mukammal karna hota hai, aur clone app app copy karta hai.

D3-195.q: Apex domain contoso.com (www ke baghair) ko App Service app se map karne ke liye kaun se DNS records use hote hain?
opts: App ke IP wala A record, sath mein verification ke liye TXT record asuid
Apex par CNAME, aur verification ke liye MX record
D3-195.exp: Zone ke apex (contoso.com) par CNAME records allowed nahi, is liye isay app ke inbound IP address ki taraf A record se map karein, sath mein asuid naam ka TXT record app ki verification ID ke sath taa ke sabit ho domain aap ka hai. MX email ke liye aur NS delegation ke liye hai.

D3-196.q: App ki tamam HTTP requests HTTPS par redirect honi chahiye. Kaun si setting?
D3-196.exp: HTTPS Only = On App Service ko har HTTP request HTTPS par redirect karwata hai. Minimum TLS version control karta hai ke kaun se TLS versions accept hon (aur 1.0 security kamzor karega), client certificates mutual TLS ke liye hain, aur Always On app ko loaded rakhta hai.

D3-197.q: Wildcard certificate (*.contoso.com) ko kai App Service apps mehfooz karni hain. Aap ko kya use karna chahiye?
opts: Certificate import karein (Key Vault ya PFX upload se)
Har app ke liye free App Service managed certificate
Portal ke zariye Let's Encrypt cert
D3-197.exp: Free App Service managed certificates wildcard domains support nahi karte. Kai apps par *.contoso.com mehfooz karne ke liye wildcard certificate import karein — Key Vault, PFX upload ya App Service certificate se — aur usay har app se bind karein. Client certificates callers authenticate karne ke liye hain, site ke liye nahi.

D3-198.q: Ek internal web app SIRF aap ke VNet aur on-premises (VPN par) se pohanch mein honi chahiye, koi public exposure nahi. Kaun sa feature?
opts: App ke liye private endpoint (aur public access disable karna)
App par aisi access restrictions jo har source address allow karein
D3-198.exp: Private endpoint app ko aap ke VNet mein private IP deta hai, is liye woh VNet se aur VPN par on-premises se pohanch mein hoti hai. Phir public network access disable karne se internet block hota hai. VNet integration sirf outbound calls ke liye hai, Hybrid Connections on-premises hosts tak pohanchte hain, aur Any allow karna app ko public rakhta hai.

D3-199.q: Custom (scheduled) App Service backups kahan store hote hain?
opts: Aap ke chune storage account container mein
GRS wale Recovery Services vault mein
D3-199.exp: Custom (scheduled ya on-demand) App Service backups ZIP aur XML files ki surat mein aap ke chune storage account container mein likhe jate hain. Automatic backups platform khud store karta hai. App Service backups Recovery Services vaults ya Key Vault use nahi karte.

D3-200.ctx: App1 Basic B1 Linux plan par chalti hai. Requirements: staging slot, CPU-based autoscale, www.contoso.com ke liye free TLS certificate, aur VM ke private IP tak outbound access.
D3-200.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: B1 staging deployment slot support karta hai
B1 rule-based autoscale support karta hai
B1 par www.contoso.com ke liye free managed certificate use ho sakta hai
B1 par regional VNet integration available hai
D3-200.exp: Basic B1 deployment slots ya rule-based autoscale support nahi karta — dono ko Standard ya upar chahiye. B1 par www.contoso.com ke liye free managed certificate chalta hai, aur Basic par regional VNet integration available hai. Is liye B1 TLS aur network requirements poori karta hai, lekin staging ya autoscale nahi.

D3-241.q: Aap nayi VMs ki encryption design kar rahe hain jo 2028 ke baad bhi chalengi. Temp disks aur caches bhi encrypt hone chahiye. Microsoft kaun sa option recommend karta hai?
opts: Key encryption key ke sath Azure Disk Encryption
Sirf platform-managed keys wali server-side encryption
D3-241.exp: Encryption at host temp disks, caches aur storage tak data flow ko cover karta hai, aur Microsoft nayi VMs ke liye yehi recommend karta hai. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga, jis ke baad encrypted disks reboot par unlock nahi hongi. Akeli server-side encryption temp disks ya caches cover nahi karti.

D3-242.q: VM1 (Windows) Azure Disk Encryption use karti hai. Aap isay encryption at host par kaise le jayenge?
opts: ADE on rehte hue hi encryption at host on kar dein
az vm encryption migrate chalayen aur VM restart karein
Key vault ki access setting EncryptionAtHost kar dein
ADE band karein, upload se nayi disks banayen, phir nayi VM banayen
D3-242.exp: Mojooda VM par seedha conversion nahi hota. Aap ADE band karte hain aur confirm karte hain ke disks poori decrypt ho gayi hain, upload method se nayi managed disks banate hain (snapshots aur disk copies ADE ka flag rakhti hain), aur un se encryption at host wali nayi VM banate hain. Is dauran VM ka downtime hota hai.

D3-243.q: Azure Disk Encryption ke muqable mein encryption at host ke kaun se DO faide hain?
opts: Yeh VM ka CPU use nahi karta
Yeh disks ko VM delete hone ke baad hi encrypt karta hai
Yeh custom Linux images ke sath kaam karta hai
Is se managed disks ki zaroorat khatam ho jati hai
D3-243.exp: Encryption at host host par chalta hai, is liye VM ka CPU use nahi karta, aur custom images ke sath kaam karta hai. Azure Disk Encryption guest ke andar chalta hai, VM ka CPU use karta hai aur custom Linux images support nahi karta. Dono VM chalte hue disks ko mehfooz rakhte hain.

D3-244.q: RG1 mein maujood resources ki Bicep file chahiye. Steps ko tarteeb dein.
items: Bani hui Bicep file dekhein aur theek karein
az bicep decompile --file main.json chalayen
az group export --name RG1 > main.json chalayen
az deployment group create se Bicep file deploy karein
D3-244.exp: Pehle resource group ko ARM JSON template mein export karein, phir us JSON ko Bicep mein decompile karein. Decompile koshish ki had tak conversion hai, poori mapping ki guarantee nahi, is liye deploy se pehle file dekh kar theek karein.

D3-245.q: Aap ek bare ARM template par az bicep decompile chalate hain. Nateeje ke bare mein kaun sa statement sahi hai?
opts: Woh hamesha insaan ki likhi file jaisa hota hai
Woh bante hi Azure par deploy ho jata hai
Yeh koshish ki had tak conversion hai jisay dekhna chahiye
Woh template ke apne resource group mein save hota hai
D3-245.exp: Decompile ARM JSON ko Bicep mein badalne ki koshish karta hai, lekin poori mapping ki guarantee nahi, is liye warnings ya errors theek karne aur naam saaf karne par sakte hain. Yeh .bicep file JSON wale folder mein likhta hai. Azure par kuch deploy nahi karta.

D3-246.q: Azure Container Instances ke ek chalte container group ko zyada memory chahiye. Aap ko kya karna hoga?
opts: Container group delete kar ke nayi value ke sath dobara deploy karein
Group chalte hue portal mein memory badal dein
Group ke memory metric par autoscale rule lagayen
Azure CLI mein --memory parameter ke sath group restart karein
D3-246.exp: Container group ki CPU, memory aur GPU requests chalte hue update nahi ho sakti. Aap group delete kar ke nayi values ke sath dobara deploy karte hain. Restart purani values rakhta hai, aur Container Instances mein autoscale rules nahi.

D3-247.q: Container group mein do containers hain. Ek 1 CPU aur 1.5 GB mangta hai, doosra 1 CPU aur 2 GB. Azure group ko kitna allocate karta hai?
D3-247.exp: Container group ko us ke tamam containers ki requests ka majmua milta hai: 1 + 1 = 2 CPU aur 1.5 + 2 = 3.5 GB memory. Containers group ke resources share karte hain, aur aap group ko allocate hui miqdar ka paisa dete hain.

D3-248.q: Aap ingress enabled wala container app banate hain aur koi scale rule define nahi karte. Default scale settings kya hain?
D3-248.exp: Koi rule na ho to Container Apps HTTP scale rule use karta hai, kam se kam 0 aur zyada se zyada 10 replicas ke sath. Kam se kam 0 hone par traffic na ho to app zero tak scale hota hai, aur zero par usage charges nahi lagte.

D3-249.q: Azure Container Apps ki scaling ke bare mein kaun se DO statements sahi hain?
opts: Replicas ki zyada se zyada tadaad 1,000 tak set ho sakti hai
Memory khatam hone par container app vertically scale hota hai
Replicas ki default kam se kam tadaad 0 hai
Scale rules sirf HTTP requests use kar sakte hain
D3-249.exp: Kam se kam replicas ka default 0 aur zyada se zyada ka 10 hai, aur zyada se zyada 1,000 tak barhaya ja sakta hai. Container Apps replicas barha kar horizontally scale hota hai: vertical scaling supported nahi. Rules HTTP, TCP ya custom (KEDA-based) triggers, jaise queue length ya CPU, use kar sakte hain.

D3-250.q: App Service backups support karne wali sab se choti pricing tier kaun si hai?
D3-250.exp: App Service backups, automatic aur custom dono, ko Basic, Standard, Premium ya Isolated tier chahiye, is liye sab se choti Basic hai. Basic mein sirf production slot ka backup ho sakta hai. Free aur Shared backups support nahi karte.

D3-251.q: Aap ko aise App Service backups chahiye jo download ho saken aur 30 din se zyada rakhe ja saken. Aap kya use karenge?
D3-251.exp: Custom backups aap ke chune hue storage account mein likhe jate hain, is liye aap unhein download kar sakte hain aur jitna chahein rakh sakte hain. Automatic backups har ghante hote hain aur 30 din rehte hain: un ki retention nahi badalti aur woh download nahi hote. Recovery Services vaults App Service apps ka backup nahi lete.

D3-252.q: App Service backups ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Automatic backups ko storage account chahiye
Automatic backups 30 din rakhe jate hain
Custom backup 10 GB tak ho sakta hai
Custom backups din mein zyada se zyada 12 dafa chal sakte hain
D3-252.exp: Automatic backups ko na storage account chahiye na setup, woh har ghante hote hain aur 30 din rehte hain. Custom backups ko storage account chahiye, har ek 10 GB tak ho sakta hai, aur woh kam se kam 2 ghante ke waqfe par, yani din mein 12 tak, chal sakte hain.

D3-253.q: Database VM ko zyada memory chahiye. Aap us ka size D4s_v5 se E8s_v5 karte hain. Yeh kaun si scaling hai?
D3-253.exp: Vertical scaling ek machine ko zyada ya kam resources deti hai, aur aam tor par VM restart hoti hai. Horizontal scaling instances ki tadaad badalti hai, jaise scale set. Predictive autoscale mutawaqqe load se pehle scale out karne ka tareeqa hai.

D3-254.q: Stateless web tier ka load achanak barhta hai, aur capacity badalne par users ko pata na chale. Sab se munasib kya hai?
opts: Peak mein ek bari VM ko scale up karna
Load balancer ke peeche VM scale set ko scale out karna
Do VMs ko baari baari haath se scale up karna
Backup se VMs restore kar ke scale out karna
D3-254.exp: Scale out load balancer ke peeche instances barhata hai aur chalti instances nahi rukti, aur autoscale rules load par amal karte hain. VM scale up karne se restart hoti hai aur size ki had hai. Backup se restore recovery hai, scaling nahi.

D3-255.q: Test VMs hafte ke dinon mein 08:00 se 18:00 tak use hoti hain. Kam mehnat mein kharcha kam karna hai, disks aur settings rahein. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Har shaam delete karein aur har subah template se dobara banayen
Auto-shutdown se deallocate karein, aur subah schedule se start karein
Har shaam Windows ke andar se band karein
Un ke liye teen saal ki reservation lein
D3-255.exp: Auto-shutdown VMs ko deallocate karta hai, is liye compute ka bill rukta hai aur disks aur settings rehti hain. Start schedule (maslan Automation runbook) unhein wapas lata hai. OS ke andar se band karne par woh allocated rehti hain aur bill aata hai, aur reservation har waqt chalne wali VMs ke liye hai.

D3-256.q: Choti public website ko TLS ke sath custom domain chahiye, autoscale ya slots nahi. Sab se sasta munasib App Service tier kaun sa hai?
D3-256.exp: Custom domain ka TLS, free managed certificates samet, Basic tier se shuru hota hai. Free mein custom domain nahi, Shared mein custom domain hai lekin us ka TLS nahi, aur Standard un features ka zyada paisa leta hai jo aap ko nahi chahiye.

D3-257.q: Container queue messages process karta hai jo din mein chand dafa aate hain. Khaali waqt mein kharcha na ho, aur servers sambhalne na paren. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: Kam se kam ek instance wala VM scale set
Queue scale rule aur minimum replicas 0 wala Azure Container Apps
Restart policy Always wala Azure Container Instances
Container ke sath Basic tier ka App Service plan
D3-257.exp: Container Apps zero tak scale hota hai aur messages aane par replicas shuru karta hai, aur zero par usage charges nahi. Always wala container instance chalta rehta hai, aur scale set ya App Service plan maujood hone tak bill hota hai.

D3-258.q: Aam Bicep deployment ke muqable mein deployment stack kya izafa karta hai?
opts: Tamam resources ko dependencies ke baghair parallel chala kar jaldi deploy karta hai
Deploy kiye resources ko ek unit rakhta hai jisay mehfooz aur saaf kiya ja sake
Bicep files ko Terraform files mein badalta hai
Template ko baghair permissions deploy karne deta hai
D3-258.exp: Deployment stack ek resource hai jo template ke resources ko ek unit ki tarah manage karta hai. Template se resource hatane par stack usay detach ya delete kar sakta hai, aur deny settings managed resources ko tabdeeli se bachati hain.

D3-259.q: Aap Bicep file se storage account hatate hain aur deployment stack ko --action-on-unmanage detachAll ke sath update karte hain. Account ka kya hoga?
opts: Apne data ke sath delete ho jayega
Azure mein rahega, lekin stack usay manage nahi karega
Dobara add hone tak band rahega
Update fail hoga kyunke resources hataye nahi ja sakte
D3-259.exp: detachAll ke sath jo resource template mein na rahe woh unmanaged ho jata hai: Azure mein rehta hai aur stack usay bhool jata hai. Aise resources delete karne ke liye deleteResources ya deleteAll use karein.

D3-260.q: Deployment stack ke resources admins badal saken lekin delete na kar saken. Kaun sa deny settings mode use karenge?
D3-260.exp: denyDelete managed resources ka delete rokta hai aur updates allow karta hai. denyWriteAndDelete dono rokta hai, none kuch nahi bachata, aur detachAll action-on-unmanage ki value hai, deny mode nahi.

D3-261.q: Deployment stack denyWriteAndDelete use karta hai. Woh storage account st1 manage karta hai. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Owner, jo excluded principal nahi, portal mein st1 delete kar sakta hai
Storage Blob Data Contributor wala user st1 ka blob phir bhi delete kar sakta hai
Deny settings un resources ko bachati hain jo template mein nahi
Stack ki hifazat deny assignments se lagti hai
D3-261.exp: Deny settings deny assignments banati hain, jo role assignments par bhari hain, is liye exclude na ho to Owner bhi ruk jata hai. Yeh sirf control-plane par hain, is liye blob delete jaise data actions chalte hain. Sirf template mein saaf likhe resources mehfooz hote hain.

D3-262.q: Portal mein supported image se bani nayi Generation 2 VM ka default security type kya hai?
opts: Koi nahi, pehle feature register karna hoga
D3-262.exp: Secure Boot aur vTPM wala Trusted launch nayi Gen2 VMs aur scale sets ka default hai, jab image, disk aur size support karein. Confidential VMs khaas sizes ke sath alag option hai.

D3-263.q: Trusted launch VM ko aisi family mein resize karna hai jo Trusted launch support nahi karti. Resize ka option nahi milta. Wajah kya hai?
opts: Resize ke liye availability set chahiye
Target size VM ka security type support kare
Trusted launch VMs banne ke baad kabhi resize nahi hoti
Pehle OS disk ephemeral honi chahiye
D3-263.exp: Trusted launch VM sirf un sizes mein resize hoti hai jo Trusted launch support karein. Doosri family ke liye VM deallocate kar ke security type Standard karni parti hai, jis se Secure Boot aur vTPM ki hifazat khatam ho jati hai.

D3-264.q: Company ko yaqeen chahiye ke ek size ki 20 VMs kisi bhi waqt region mein start ho saken, capacity kam ho tab bhi. Aap kya banayenge?
opts: Teen saal ki reserved VM instance
D3-264.exp: On-demand capacity reservation region ya zone mein ek VM size ki compute capacity rok kar rakhta hai. Reserved instance qeemat ki chhoot hai, capacity nahi rokti. Proximity placement group latency ke liye hai, aur Spot capacity wapas li ja sakti hai.

D3-265.q: On-demand capacity reservations ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Koi VM use na kare tab bhi reserved capacity ka paisa lagta hai
VM reservation tab use karti hai jab us ka hawala de
Spot VMs reservation use kar sakti hain
Mojooda reservation ka VM size badla ja sakta hai
D3-265.exp: Reserved capacity ka bill VM size ki qeemat par aata hai, use ho ya na ho. VM ko use karne ke liye capacity reservation group ka hawala dena hota hai. Spot VMs supported nahi, aur banne ke baad sirf tadaad badalti hai.

D3-266.ctx: Ek web app Basic (B1) tier ke App Service plan par chalti hai. Naye versions baghair downtime release karne hain aur pichle version par jaldi wapas aana hai.

D3-266.exp: Slots Standard se shuru hote hain. Naya version staging slot mein deploy aur warm up hota hai, swap mein downtime nahi, aur dobara swap karne se pichla version wapas aa jata hai.

D3-267.ctx: Ek web app Basic (B1) tier ke App Service plan par chalti hai. Naye versions baghair downtime release karne hain aur pichle version par jaldi wapas aana hai.

D3-267.exp: Zyada instances naye version ko alag jagah deploy aur warm up karne nahi deti, aur purane version par jaldi wapsi nahi hoti. Deployment slots isi ke liye hain, aur unhein Standard ya us se upar ka tier chahiye.

D3-268.q: VM scale set ki autoscale settings dekhein. Abhi 4 instances hain, aur aaj Tuesday hai. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: 10 minute 80% average CPU par 6 instances ho jati hain
10 minute 20% average CPU par 3 instances reh jati hain
95% average CPU par 12 instances tak barh sakta hai
Saturday ko schedule minimum 1 karta hai
D3-268.exp: Scale-out rule 2 instances barhata hai, is liye 4 se 6. Scale-in rule 1 kam karta hai, is liye 4 se 3, jo weekday minimum 2 se upar hai. Maximum 10 se kabhi nahi barhta. Weekend profile ka minimum 1 hai.

D3-269.q: Yeh Bicep file env = 'test' ke sath chalane par kya deploy karti hai?
opts: Do storage accounts, har SKU ka ek
Kuch nahi, kyunke condition false hai
D3-269.exp: SKU ka expression conditional hai: env 'prod' ho to Standard_GRS, warna Standard_LRS. Resource par khud "if" nahi, is liye hamesha deploy hota hai, aur @allowed 'test' qubool karta hai.

D3-270.q: Yeh Bicep file kaise yaqeeni banati hai ke NIC VM se pehle bane?
opts: dependsOn se, jo har Bicep resource mein likhna lazmi hai
nic.id ke hawale se, jo implicit dependency banata hai
File mein resources ki tarteeb se
D3-270.exp: Ek resource ka symbolic name doosre mein use karne se implicit dependency banti hai, is liye Resource Manager pehle NIC deploy karta hai. File mein tarteeb ki ahmiyat nahi, aur dependsOn sirf tab chahiye jab hawala na ho.

D3-271.q: Yeh PowerShell script kya karta hai?
opts: vm1 ko resize kar ke dobara start karta hai
vm1 delete kar ke naye size mein banata hai
Naye size mein vm1 ki copy banata hai
vm1 resize karta hai lekin band chhorta hai
D3-271.exp: Stop-AzVM VM ko deallocate karta hai, script VM object mein size badalta hai, Update-AzVM lagu karta hai, aur Start-AzVM VM start karta hai. Kuch delete ya copy nahi hota. Pehle deallocate karne se woh sizes bhi milte hain jo mojooda hardware par nahi.

D3-272.ctx: Ek web app Basic (B1) tier ke App Service plan par chalti hai. Naye versions baghair downtime release karne hain aur pichle version par jaldi wapas aana hai.
D3-272.q: Hal: Aap plan ko Premium v3 par scale up karte hain, naye versions auto swap wale staging slot mein deploy karte hain, aur wapsi ke liye dobara swap karte hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D3-272.exp: Premium mein bhi slots hain. Auto swap mein app staging slot mein warm up ho kar baghair downtime production mein swap hoti hai. Pichla version phir staging slot mein hota hai, is liye ek aur swap usay jaldi wapas lata hai.
